title: Woman Flees Hit And Run Crash Then Tries Playing Dumb
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On September 27th, 2023. An officer was an eye witness to a hit and run crash which involved a woman in a blue truck speeding off from the scene. The woman parked her car a random apartment complex and then started walking away from the car, she left her drivers license and wallet  behind in the car. When officers approached her, she pretended like she just wasn’t involved in a crash, she was acting completely clueless. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
